description: Adjust a color using perceptual (oklch, hct) or classic (hsl) math: lighten, darken, saturate, desaturate, hue-shift, tint (mix with white), shade (mix with black), grayscale, invert, or mix with a second color. Perceptual space ('oklch' default) prevents muddy mixes and hue drift.

amount.description: Amount of change. Percent (0-100) for lighten/darken/saturate/desaturate/tint/shade, degrees (-360..360) for hue-shift, or 0-1 weight of first color for mix. Default 10 / 30 / 0.5.

color.description: Color to adjust (hex, CSS name, rgb, hsl, oklch)

space.description: Color space for adjustment: 'oklch' (default, perceptually uniform), 'hct', or 'hsl'

name: adjust_color
